title: Smugglers Notch RV Village

services.name: RV Sites
services.desc: Smugglers Notch RV Village is nestled in Vermont's scenic Lamoille Valley, offering 60 full-hookup RV sites just minutes from Jeffersonville, Smugglers' Notch Resort, and Stowe. Choose from pull-through or back-in sites with 20/30 amp or Deluxe 20/30/50 amp service. Every site includes water, sewer, electricity, a picnic table, and a fire ring, with level gravel pads for easy access and friendly hosts to welcome you. Enjoy convenient amenities like a bathhouse, camp store, pickleball, and yard games, then explore nearby hiking, biking, disc golf, swimming, breweries, wineries, Cold Hollow Cider Mill, and The Alchemist Brewery.
